adversarial_claim: A correction reports what its signer could not: an executor's quality report, unqualified, becomes a qualified positive task_quality unit when the executor corrects it.

events.rationale: Draft 14.2: task quality is the observation of an authorized evaluator or task owner; a signer registered only as executor may not report QUALITY.

Draft 14.6 rule 10: the events a correction supersedes must be QUALIFIED or DISPUTED; quality-event-0001 is UNQUALIFIED, so the correction is UNQUALIFIED, supersedes nothing and adds nothing. A correction is classified as a report of the kind it corrects from its signer, so it cannot add what its signer could not report.
